name: APS — Autorisation Provisoire de Séjour (post-study job seeker)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires having completed a qualifying degree (typically at least Master's level, though some Bachelor's-level qualifications also qualify) at a French institution.

evidence_required.document: Degree certificate from the French institution

sources.title: Légifrance — CESEDA, autorisation provisoire de séjour recherche d'emploi/création d'entreprise

notes: Full, unrestricted work rights during the search period — a real advantage over UK Graduate and Germany's post-study job-seeker permit in terms of immediate flexibility, though shorter than the Netherlands' 18-month Orientation Year equivalent. Closes France's core Journey chain (Student → APS → Talent/standard work → Carte de résident → Citizenship), the same structural pattern seen in every other country's dataset so far. Non-renewable and terminal within its own term — must convert to a work/business route before expiry or leave France, same pattern as UK Graduate, Germany's Job Seeker permit, and the Netherlands' Orientation Year.
